mentions.name: gsql
mentions.description: A domain-specific language that adds parametric polymorphism to SQL, together with a compiler for it, aiming to eliminate repetitive schema patterns when writing SQL. A source repository and an in-browser playground are available.
mentions.problem: Repetitive schema pattern issues in SQL, which the author had long been looking to solve.
mentions.source_excerpt: This week I created a DSL that allows parametric polymorphism for SQL, and I wrote a compiler for it.

evidence.value: This week I created a DSL that allows parametric polymorphism for SQL, and I wrote a compiler for it.
